column7: Decides whether a firewall judges cross-tenant reads at all (attribution configured, mode not off); a wrong None turns every read check off and lets withheld reads through.
Takes the tenant attribution of a raw value before a transform or redaction drops fields; a missed tenant here is never charged and a cross-tenant read is released.
Builds the emitted document scan walks for member-name matches; a field left out of it is never scanned, so a tenant named there escapes the verdict.
Matches a configured key equal to result or error data against the raw value, the one match the placeholders hide; a mistake drops that tenant from the verdict.
Collects the tenants every payload kind names (minus jsonrpc and id) for the verdict; a payload or field it skips is released unjudged.
Checks the attribution against the caller key's read history and returns Blocked, Flagged or Unattributable, reserving the read; a mistake releases a cross-tenant read or charges the wrong caller.
Decides which verdicts withhold the frame (Blocked always, Unattributable under block); a wrong false delivers a read the judge refused.
Decides whether the request's tenants and hidden attribution are charged to the answer (result, not error); a wrong false lets a delivered read of tenant B go uncharged.
Judges an answer for the caller key and replaces a withheld one with the fixed refusal, binding the frame to that key; a mistake leaks another tenant's answer.
Judges a notification, server-to-client request or event delivery and returns Blocked with rejection evidence when withheld; a mistake delivers a withheld cross-tenant read.
Judges a session-stream item (data, event name and wrapper) for one session's caller and blocks it when withheld; a mistake sends a withheld read to that session.
Writes one tenant_read event and returns false when the write fails under FailClosed, the signal that withholds the frame; a wrong true delivers content with no audit record.
Writes a judged frame's tenant_read event and reports a FailClosed failure that withholds it; a wrong true sends a judged read with no audit record.
Under FailClosed replaces an answer with the audit-unavailable refusal, or withholds any other frame, when its tenant_read record fails; a mistake sends unaudited backend content.
Writes an HTTP answer's pending tenant_read record and replaces the answer with a 503 audit-unavailable refusal when it fails under FailClosed; a mistake sends an unaudited answer.
Refuses to send a callback frame judged for another principal or one that is not a callback body; a mistake posts one subscriber's judged read to another.
Decides whether a sink bound to a destination may write a frame judged for a caller key; a wrong true writes a read judged for one caller to another.
Returns a POST-stream frame only when the judge admits it under the bound key, and audits and drops a blocked one; a mistake sends a withheld notification.
Judges one session's copy of a stream item for that session's caller and returns Err after auditing a blocked one; a mistake fans a withheld read out to that session.
Builds a frame with no assessment, key or ticket for the fast path; used for backend content while judging is on it would silently skip the judge.
Tells the events worker and SSE stream that a fail-closed audit withheld the frame so they skip sending it; the withhold decision is recorded's.
Decides whether a frame counts as a delivered result for relay receipts (COLLUDE.1); a wrong false hides delivered content from relay detection.
Swaps a frame for a gateway refusal and drops its ticket and holds; keeping the ticket would commit a read the caller never got, keeping holds would leak them.
Empties a frame to Withheld and drops its reservation when a late check refuses it; a mistake would leave content or commit an unsent read.
Reports whether a guard judges frames, which decides whether callers form a caller key at all; the decision is judge::judging, and a wrong false turns judging off upstream.
Routes an answer to judge::delivered when a guard exists and otherwise builds it unjudged; a mistake here skips the read judge for every answer.
Routes a direct-route JSON answer to judge::delivered when a guard exists; a mistake would send direct answers unjudged.
Routes a withheld-when-blocked frame to judge::admit when a guard exists; a mistake would admit notifications and callbacks unjudged.
Returns the pre-transform attribution from judge::attribute only when judging is on; a wrong None hides tenants the transform dropped from the verdict.
Returns the arg_keys policy an outbox record's attribution is valid under; a wrong value would let a stale attribution stand for a changed policy.
Runs a dispatch inside a read scope when judging so its pre-transform reads are noted; skipping the scope hides those reads from the judge.
Hands a frame's tenant_read fields to the caller's own delivery record once and suppresses the standalone record; a mistake drops or duplicates the read audit.
Runs emit_pending's fail-closed record write and commits relay receipts only for an answer sent as built; the withhold decision is emit_pending's.
Moves a pending tenant_read record and held id to a late replacement; dropping them would send the replacement with no record of the original verdict.
Writes an answer frame as the HTTP response and leaves its tenant_read record pending; a mistake would skip the fail-closed record or commit an unread body.
Serializes a reserved answer and commits its reservation only when the body is first polled; a mistake would commit reads the caller never received.
Judges an event delivery through admission and counts a record with no carried attribution as unread; dropping that default would release an unattributed read.
Hands a withheld frame's rejection to a bounded detached audit task and counts saturation; the content is withheld by the judge either way.
Runs the fail-closed record write via emit_http_checked and hands off sealed holds only for an answer it let through; the withhold decision is emit_pending's.
Hands off an answer's sealed holds only when its delivery record let it through; a wrong hand-off keeps slots alive for a refused answer.
Builds the session-stream judge only when the guard judges; a wrong None turns judging off for every GET session stream.
Binds the caller key a POST stream's frames are judged under, first binding wins; a wrong key charges reads to another caller.
Judges a stored task's output as unattributable when attribution is on; dropping that hidden attribution would release it as tenant-free.
Supplies the uninspected attribution for a restored document when the guard attributes; a wrong None lets stored output pass unjudged.
Charges the listen request's own params to the acknowledgement's judgement; dropping them lets a request naming tenant B go uncharged.
Records a session item's judgement before committing it and withholds the item when the record fails under FailClosed; the record decision is audit::record.
Serializes a frame for SSE, returns None for Withheld and batch frames, and commits its reservation; a mistake would write a withheld frame or commit an unsent one.
Decides whether a judgement needs a tenant_read audit record and builds its fields; an empty result skips the audit write a withheld read must leave.
Releases a callback frame's reservation when nothing left the process; releasing a delivered read would erase history later tenant decisions need.
Commits a callback frame's reservation once its body may be on the wire; a skipped commit drops history later tenant decisions need.
Commits a written frame's read to the ticket history that later tenant-read decisions consult; a missed commit lets a later read look first.
Wraps a stream response whose frames the stream judges handle; used without them, its content would reach the client unjudged.
Marks an answer as gateway-authored so it is written unjudged; used for backend content, it silently skips the judge, as unjudged does.
Installs the guard and audit logger a POST stream judges with; a missing guard or logger silently turns stream enforcement off.
